bard.instrument_note: the quality of the instrument Logan plays (run.py --instrument for another; user 2026-10-25: 'Barding depends on the quality of the instrument', not its kind): its bonus to the effective barding skill E = 80 skill (tamer barding) + this + the Mastery Chain's Effective Barding (sim/chain.py). Bonuses: wiki Magic Item Modifiers #13809 (surpassingly 10 .. supremely 25), melodious 5 (forum KB). The songs fix E (SONG below) and so the bonus: 15.0 % before the links (E 100: exceedingly, 2026-10-13 17:39), then 16.2 / 16.9 / 17.7 / 18.4 % = E 108 / 113 / 118 / 123 with the +18 links: surpassingly / eminently (the sackbut, 2026-10-24) / exceedingly (the psaltery, 2026-10-25) / supremely (since 2026-10-25 17:36: the bamboo flute, after its loss at the 2026-10-26 00:32 death a shawm; docs/OVERSEER.md). No Item Identification (knowledge #3870 would multiply the bonus)
bard.chance_note: p = max((E + bonus - d) / 100, 0.33 x (E + bonus) / 100), at most 1 (knowledge #8530 #5239 #11223); bonus `barded_bonus` on a target already barded (Peacemaking on one discorded, pacified or provoked, Provocation with either creature so: the durations, seconds_note). Since 2026-10-27 not on a Discordance's chance (its duration keeps it): live 34 of 47 Discordances on provoked creatures succeeded, 33.7 expected without the bonus, 44.0 with. d per skill and type: `difficulty` (sim/bard_scan.py: the maximum-likelihood d of each type's 10+ live answers 2026-10-15..26, each at the E its song printed), else the scenario's `capture_d` (its hand-play fit), else the Guide's chance (`guide`, Tidal Tomb), else the skill's median d; a Provocation's d from `provoke_d`. One point of E is one point of chance: on the 3,000 live Discordances at E 108-123 a slope of 1 fits better than none by 4.8 in log-likelihood (Peacemaking 4.6; docs/SIM.md 'Barding from the effective skill'). No 95 % cap: raw flesh and newly reanimated took 120 of 120. The wiki difficulty is not the server's: the fitted d sit at 23-57 for Discordance on types the wiki puts at 67-205
bard.seconds_note: a success lasts ceil(base x (E + bonus) / 100 x (1 + the chain's Barding Effect Durations)) s, the same for every type: 2,977 of the 2,999 live answers 2026-10-15..26 (the rest an instrument changed within the hour: bard_observed durations), e.g. discord 65 / 68 / 71 / 74 s at E 108 / 113 / 118 / 123 and 80-89 s barded; peace 43 s at E 118 is 30 x 143 (Logan pacifies what he discorded), 36 s without; provoke 36 s or 43 s at E 118, 43 s in 70 of 83: the bonus with the creature incited not discorded, so it counts the one it is incited onto (Logan's discorded target), +25 not the wiki's 12.5 a creature
bard.note: discord 16.67 % at 80 printed: it scales with the printed skill, not the effective one (knowledge #11224), so neither the instrument nor the links move it; act_threat: an aggressive act of ours draws the mob onto the character (user 2026-10-12) [INFERENCE: worth 400 damage of threat], only while no pet has hurt it yet (the trip: our acts after the pets' first damage drew none of 14 monsters onto Logan; of 7 reached first, 3 hit him; docs/NOTES.md); a failed Provocation draws no more (live the incited creature newly hit Logan after 1 of 132 failed provocations, 26 of 1,032 failed discords); break_threat likewise; range 12 [INFERENCE] (successes at 1-9 tiles); provoke_x: the hue-2417 numbers between two provoked creatures over the attacker's melee on a pet, the hit-weighted median of 690 hits of 30 types 7.1 (Mausoleum median 134 a hit, Tidal Tomb 185; [INFERENCE] each number put on the pair's other creature), 4 before 2026-10-27 (n=29); a pair fights a median 6.4 s until one is gone

provoke_d.note: a Provocation's d is the mean of the two creatures' Discordance d plus 31.5: 343 live answers 2026-10-15..27 (211 ok), log-likelihood -213.8 against -228.8 for the per-type provoke fits of bard_observed (which made it fail too often: 177.7 expected ok against 211; live .615, sim .518); expected 208.2 (docs/NOTES.md 'Bard rates and cooldowns live')
